class.name: GameState
class.brief_description: Class that provides the functionality of a classic Game State, with an _on_update(), _on_enter(), and _on_exit() that must be written by the user. _process() and other node-related functions such as input can also be defined.
class.description: This class can be used to
class.tutorials:
```gdscript # test_state.gd extends GameState
func _on_enter() -> void: print("--- TEST STATE ENTERED ---")
func _on_update(delta: float) -> void: print("TestState updating... delta: ", delta) GSM.pop_state(); # global GSM singleton can be called whenever!
func _on_exit() -> void: print("--- TEST STATE EXITED ---") ```
